newsitem.title: UK: Fitness First raises 8 million stg with placing.
newsitem.headline: Fitness First raises 8 million stg with placing.

text.p: Fitness First Plc, an operator of health and fitness clubs, said on Thursday it raised 8.0 million stg with a placing of new shares at 80p valuing it at 22.0 million stg.

"We are delighted with the excellent level of interest that the placing has attracted, and with the high quality of the institutions which have taken up shares," said managing director Michael Balfour.
Fitness First shares, placed by broker Henderson Crosthwaite, are due to start trading on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on October 16.

"The strong level of interest in the placing is a reflection of the considerable opportunity that the directors of Fitness First believe the company has to roll out its successful formula to become a leading health and fitness club operator," Balfour said.
